description: Canonical mandate schema for E4A protocol 1.0. Derived from specs/mandate_v2.json per maintainer decision D1 (see docs/project-status.md). Changes from mandate_v2: explicit protocol versioning ($id, protocol_version), optional expires_at, and closed objects (additionalProperties: false) at the top level and inside intent.

amount.description: Optional amount associated with the mandate. In v1 this is record-keeping only; execution is mock and moves no value.

beneficiary.description: Actor identifier of the mandate beneficiary.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp assigned by the implementation when the mandate is stored. Present on stored records and responses; not required on submission.

expires_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 expiry. An expired mandate MUST NOT be executed (spec section 5).

fee_distribution.description: Optional fee shares (protocol, validator, issuer) used by the reference implementation's mock fee computation.

contextual_tone.description: The desired tone or style of interaction (e.g. 'collaborative', 'urgent', 'formal').

expected_outcome.description: The desired result or state upon successful completion.

goal.description: The explicit objective of the mandate.

requires_approval.description: Actor identifiers that must ALL approve before execution; ANY one of them may reject. Absent or empty means no approval is required.

statistical_purpose.description: The underlying statistical or meta-level objective of the action.

issuer.description: Actor identifier of the mandate issuer (DID-shaped string; v1 performs no cryptographic verification — see spec section 9).

mandate_id.description: Unique mandate identifier. If absent on submission, the implementation assigns one (UUID4) before validation of the stored record.

parent_mandate_id.description: Parent mandate for sub-mandates; null or absent for top-level mandates.

proof_anchor.description: Reserved. External anchoring is deferred in v1; implementations MUST NOT require this field.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version. Optional on submission; absence means 1.0. Implementations MUST store and return it.

replay_nonce.description: Idempotency key. The pair (issuer, replay_nonce) MUST be unique; see spec section 6.

validator_ref.description: Reserved. Validator networks are deferred in v1; implementations MUST NOT require this field.

title: E4A Mandate — Protocol 1.0 (canonical)
